steps.note: Fat-filled whey powder carries 30–60 % fat, and a replacer is typically 20–26 % fat.
Homogenising the fat in helps against fouling in the drier.
Spray-dried in a wide-body drier with about 180 °C air in and 90–95 °C air out.
